fire: After the storm warning, hundreds of families packed up and left their houses before dawn.
Hikers should always carry their maps in a waterproof bag.
The students quietly closed their books when the bell rang.
Many workers lost their jobs when the factory shut down.
Parents are asked to label their children's lunch boxes clearly.
The soldiers cleaned their rifles before the inspection.
Most commuters keep their phones in their pockets on the train.
Thousands of residents were forced to abandon their farms during the drought.
